reports.title: Organizations
reports.query:
MATCH (org:GraphOrg)-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(tenant:Tenant)
RETURN 
  org.displayName AS OrganizationName,
  org.tenantType AS TenantType,
  tenant.tenantId AS TenantId,
  tenant.countryCode AS CountryCode,
  org.onPremisesSyncEnabled AS SyncEnabled,
  org.onPremisesLastSyncDateTime AS LastSyncDate

reports.title: Organization Domains
reports.query:
MATCH (org:GraphOrg)-[:VERIFIED_DOMAIN]->(domain:VerifiedDomain)
RETURN 
  org.displayName AS OrganizationName,
  org.id AS TenantId,
  domain.name AS DomainName,
  domain.isDefault AS IsDefault,
  domain.isInitial AS IsInitial,
  domain.type AS DomainType
ORDER BY org.displayName, domain.isDefault DESC

reports.title: Authorization Policies
reports.query:
MATCH (o:GraphOrg)-[:HAS_POLICY]->(p:GraphPolicy{type:"authorizationpolicy"})
RETURN
  o.id AS OrgId,
  o.displayName AS OrgName,
  p.allowEmailVerifiedUsersToJoinOrganization AS allowEmailVerifiedUsersToJoinOrganization,
  p.allowInvitesFrom AS allowInvitesFrom,
  p.allowUserConsentForRiskyApps AS allowUserConsentForRiskyApps,
  p.allowedToSignUpEmailBasedSubscriptions AS allowedToSignUpEmailBasedSubscriptions,
  p.allowedToUseSSPR AS allowedToUseSSPR,
  p.blockMsolPowerShell AS blockMsolPowerShell,
  p.allowedToCreateApps AS allowedToCreateApps,
  p.allowedToCreateSecurityGroups AS allowedToCreateSecurityGroups,
  p.allowedToCreateTenants AS allowedToCreateTenants,
  p.allowedToReadBitlockerKeysForOwnedDevice AS allowedToReadBitlockerKeysForOwnedDevice,
  p.allowedToReadOtherUsers AS allowedToReadOtherUsers

reports.title: Other Active Entra ID Roles
reports.query:
// 1. Direct Role Assignment
MATCH (o:GraphObject)-[:HAS_ROLE]->(g:GraphRole)
WHERE NOT g.displayName =~ 'Global Administrator|User Administrator|Cloud Application Administrator|Authentication Policy Administrator|Exchange Administrator|Helpdesk Administrator|Privileged Authentication Administrator'
RETURN 
  o.displayName AS MemberName,
  o.userPrincipalName AS UPN,
  labels(o)[1] AS Type,
  null AS GroupName, 
  g.displayName AS RoleName

UNION

// 2. Group-Inherited Role Assignment
MATCH (o:GraphObject)-[:MEMBER_OF*..]->(group:GraphGroup)-[:HAS_ROLE]->(g:GraphRole)
WHERE NOT g.displayName =~ 'Global Administrator|User Administrator|Cloud Application Administrator|Authentication Policy Administrator|Exchange Administrator|Helpdesk Administrator|Privileged Authentication Administrator'
RETURN 
  o.displayName AS MemberName,
  o.userPrincipalName AS UPN,
  labels(o)[1] AS Type,
  group.displayName AS GroupName, 
  g.displayName AS RoleName

reports.title: Entra ID Devices
reports.query:
MATCH (d:GraphDevice)
WHERE d.accountEnabled = true
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[r:REGISTERED_USER|REGISTERED_OWNER]->(d)
WITH d, o,
     collect(DISTINCT TYPE(r)) AS relTypes
WITH d, o,
     CASE
       WHEN "REGISTERED_USER" IN relTypes AND "REGISTERED_OWNER" IN relTypes THEN "REGISTERED_USER | REGISTERED_OWNER"
       WHEN "REGISTERED_USER" IN relTypes THEN "REGISTERED_USER"
       WHEN "REGISTERED_OWNER" IN relTypes THEN "REGISTERED_OWNER"
       ELSE null
     END AS RelationshipType
RETURN
  o.userPrincipalName AS UPN,
  RelationshipType,
  d.deviceId AS DeviceId,
  d.displayName AS DeviceName,
  d.profileType AS ProfileType,
  d.trustType AS TrustType,
  d.isCompliant AS Compliant,
  d.operatingSystem AS OS,
  d.operatingSystemVersion AS OSVersion

reports.title: Devices with Multiple Registered Users/Owners
reports.query:
MATCH (d:GraphDevice)
WHERE d.accountEnabled = true
OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[r:REGISTERED_USER|REGISTERED_OWNER]->(d)
WITH d, collect(DISTINCT o) AS users, collect(DISTINCT TYPE(r)) AS relTypes
WHERE size(users) > 1
UNWIND users AS o
WITH d, o,
     CASE
       WHEN "REGISTERED_USER" IN relTypes AND "REGISTERED_OWNER" IN relTypes THEN "REGISTERED_USER | REGISTERED_OWNER"
       WHEN "REGISTERED_USER" IN relTypes THEN "REGISTERED_USER"
       WHEN "REGISTERED_OWNER" IN relTypes THEN "REGISTERED_OWNER"
       ELSE null
     END AS RelationshipType
RETURN
  o.userPrincipalName AS UPN,
  RelationshipType,
  d.deviceId AS DeviceId,
  d.displayName AS DeviceName,
  d.profileType AS ProfileType,
  d.trustType AS TrustType,
  d.isCompliant AS Compliant,
  d.operatingSystem AS OS,
  d.operatingSystemVersion AS OSVersion

reports.title: Secrets and Certs
reports.query:
MATCH (a:GraphApplication|GraphServicePrincipal)
MATCH (s:ClientSecret|Certificate)-[:AUTHENTICATES]->(a)
RETURN
  a.appId AS appId,
  a.displayName AS DisplayName,
  labels(s)[0] AS CredType,
  s.displayName AS CredName,
  s.hint AS ClientSecretHint,
  s.type AS CertificateType,
  s.thumbprint AS CertificateThumbprint,
  s.startDateTime AS CertificateStartTime,
  s.endDateTime AS CertificateEndTime

reports.title: Managed Identity Role Assignments
reports.query:

WHERE p.roleName IS NOT NULL
RETURN
  o.id AS ArmResource,
  o.name AS Name,
  p.roleName AS RoleName,
  labels(a)[1] AS Type,
  a.name AS ResourceName,
  a.id AS ResourceId

reports.title: App Roles
reports.query:
MATCH (o:GraphObject)-[r:APPROLE]->(t:GraphObject)
WHERE r.isEnabled = true
UNWIND t.replyUrls AS replyUrl
RETURN
  o.id AS id,
  o.displayName AS displayName,
  r.displayName AS appRoleName,
  t.displayName AS appName,
  replyUrl

  labels(t)[1] AS OwnedType,
  t.displayName AS OwnedName

reports.title: Direct Permissions to Subscriptions
reports.query:
MATCH (o)-[r]->(s:Subscription)
WHERE r.roleName is NOT NULL
RETURN
  o.displayName AS displayName,
  o.userPrincipalName AS UPN,
  r.roleName AS role,
  s.subscriptionId AS Id,
  s.displayName AS Name

reports.title: Direct Permissions to Resource Groups
reports.query:
MATCH (o)-[r]->(g:ResourceGroup)
MATCH (s:Subscription)-[c]->(g)
WHERE r.roleName is NOT NULL
RETURN
  o.displayName,
  o.userPrincipalName AS UPN,
  r.roleName,
  g.name AS RgName,
  s.displayName AS SubName

reports.title: Direct Permissions to Resources
reports.query:
MATCH (o)-[r]->(a:ArmResource)
MATCH (s:Subscription)-[]->(g:ResourceGroup)-[]->(a)
WHERE r.roleName is NOT NULL
RETURN
  o.displayName AS UPN,
  r.roleName AS RoleName,
  a.name AS Name,
  a.type AS Type,
  g.name AS RgName,
  s.displayName AS SubName

reports.title: Direct Key Vault Permissions
reports.query:
MATCH (n:GraphObject)-[r]->(v:KeyVault)
RETURN 
  n.id as id,
  labels(n)[0] as type,
  n.displayName as displayName,
  r.roleName AS roleName,
  v.id AS vaultId

reports.title: Transitive Key Vault Paths
reports.query:
MATCH (n:GraphObject)-[r*1..5]->(v:KeyVault)
WHERE ANY(rel IN r WHERE rel.roleType IS NOT NULL)
RETURN 
  n.id AS id, 
  labels(n)[0] AS type, 
  n.displayName AS displayName, 
  v.id AS vaultId,  
  [rel IN r | 
    type(rel) + "->" + coalesce(endNode(rel).displayName, endNode(rel).name, "Unnamed")
  ] AS relationshipTypesWithDirection

reports.title: Virtual Machines with Public IPs
reports.query:
MATCH (vm:VirtualMachine)-[:HAS_NIC]->(ni:NetworkInterface)-[:HAS_NSG]->(:NSG)-[:HAS_RULE]-(rule:NSGRule)
WHERE rule.access = "Allow" AND NOT toLower(rule.type) CONTAINS "defaultsecurityrules"
OPTIONAL MATCH (ni)-[:HAS_IPCONFIG]->(ipcon:IpConfiguration)-[:HAS_IP]->(ip:PublicIPAddress)
OPTIONAL MATCH (vn:VirtualNetwork)-[:CONTAINS]->(sub:Subnet)-[:CONTAINS]->(ipcon)
WITH DISTINCT vm,  rule, vn, sub,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT ipcon.privateIPAddress) AS privateIps, 
     COLLECT(DISTINCT ip.ipAddress) AS publicIps,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT rule.sourceAddressPrefix) AS sourceAddressPrefix,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT rule.sourcePortRange) AS sourcePorts,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT rule.sourcePortRanges) AS sourcePortRanges,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT rule.destinationAddressPrefix) as destinationAddressPrefix,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT rule.destinationPortRange) AS destinationPorts,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT rule.destinationPortRanges) AS destinationPortRanges
RETURN vm.name AS name,
       vm.os AS os,
       rule.name AS ruleName,
       rule.access AS access,
       rule.direction AS direction,
       vn.name AS virtualNetworkName,
       sub.addressPrefix as addressPrefix,
       privateIps[0] AS privateIp, 
       publicIps[0] AS publicIP,
       sourceAddressPrefix,
       rule.sourceAddressPrefixes AS sourceAddressPrefixes,
       sourcePorts,
       sourcePortRanges,
       destinationAddressPrefix,
       rule.destinationAddressPrefixes AS destinationAddressPrefixes,
       destinationPorts,
       destinationPortRanges

reports.title: NSG Rules
reports.query:
MATCH (nsg:NSG)-[:HAS_RULE]-(rule:NSGRule)
WHERE rule.access = "Allow"
WITH DISTINCT nsg, rule,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT rule.sourceAddressPrefix) AS sourceAddressPrefix,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT rule.sourcePortRange) AS sourcePorts,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT rule.sourcePortRanges) AS sourcePortRanges,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT rule.destinationAddressPrefix) as destinationAddressPrefix,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT rule.destinationPortRange) AS destinationPorts,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT rule.destinationPortRanges) AS destinationPortRanges
RETURN nsg.id AS id,
       nsg.name AS NsgName,
       rule.name AS ruleName,
       rule.access AS access,
       rule.direction AS direction,
       sourceAddressPrefix,
       rule.sourceAddressPrefixes AS sourceAddressPrefixes,
       sourcePorts,
       sourcePortRanges,
       destinationAddressPrefix,
       rule.destinationAddressPrefixes AS destinationAddressPrefixes,
       destinationPorts,
       destinationPortRanges
